newsitem.title: USA: Rubin says strong dollar in U.S. interest.
newsitem.headline: Rubin says strong dollar in U.S. interest.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Thursday reiterated that a strong dollar is in the interest of the United States.
"I believe without question that a strong dollar is in our interest. It has been our policy, it will continue to be our policy," Rubin said.
Rubin also told reporters before speaking to the U.S.-Saudi Business Council that the United States has had two "good" meetings with Russian officials.
"We came out of there with a good sense that they're committed to continuing their reform programs," he said.
Rubin added that one of the subjects of discussion was for the Russians to open up their financial markets, and continuing to move toward liberalization of their economy.
Rubin said U.S. inflation remains low and that he sees no signs of price pressures.
"Inflation remains low," Rubin said. "If you ask me do I see signs of reignition of inflation, the answer is no, I do not."
